GUIDE_MOVE_DETAIL: Drag the glowing joystick toward the arrow. The first enemies wait along the path.
GUIDE_OVERVIEW_DETAIL: Drag the joystick at the bottom of the map to walk. Let go and your hero fights nearby enemies. Tap loot to pick it up.
CONTRACT_NEEDS: Collect the full count of each outfit first.
CONTENT_COLLECTION_O1_DESCRIPTION: Pick up 21 each of the Blue Cap, Red Scarf and Chef Hat outfits (Winter I drops). Submit hands in 20 of each and you keep one
CONTENT_COLLECTION_O2_DESCRIPTION: Pick up 31 each of the Straw Hat, Sunglasses and Yellow Cap outfits (Summer I drops). Submit hands in 30 of each and you keep one
CONTENT_COLLECTION_O3_DESCRIPTION: Pick up 41 each of the Bunny Ears, Cat Ears and Elf Ears outfits (Spring I drops). Submit hands in 40 of each and you keep one
LINK_OPEN_FAILED: The link couldn't be opened. Check your connection and try again.
GUIDE_CHOOSE_DETAIL: Every mode plays the same game. Only the amount of help changes.
GUIDE_MODE_GUIDED_DETAIL: Step-by-step lessons with pointers. Menus open as you learn them.
GUIDE_MODE_BASIC_DETAIL: A few short cards on controls and goals. Every menu is open.
GUIDE_MODE_NONE_DETAIL: No lessons or tips. Every menu is open from the start.
